stem.text: Two students, P and Q, were asked to draw bar charts to represent how some properties of the halogens and their compounds differ in magnitude. Their diagrams are shown. The bar charts show trends only and not actual values.

stem.alt: Student P bar chart: solubility of AgX(s) in NH3(aq) for Cl, Br and I, bars increasing from Cl to Br to I.
Student Q bar chart: standard enthalpy change (delta H, standard) for H2(g) + X2(g) -> 2HX(g) for Cl, Br and I, bars below zero, most negative for Cl and least negative for I.

stem.text: Which of the students have drawn bar charts which show the trends correctly?
